quotes.text: Ordinary noCommit Pull passed in the combined runtime, but styled native desktop Pull rejected the installed executable hook: `Isolated Pull does not yet reproduce active Git hooks.` The scoped candidate accepts only the exact standalone `hooks/commit-msg` hook with mode `0755` and pinned digest, using a byte-for-byte private copy and proof checks; custom, appended, symbolic, external, or nonstandard hooks stay unsupported. [Task 1]
